Game Overview

Red and Blue Stickman Huggy is a two-player title where guide the quirky Red and Blue Stickman siblings through exciting adventures, collecting keys and unlocking doors. Master teamwork, strategy, and double jumps to navigate tricky levels. The balance of engaging puzzles and cooperative gameplay offers a delightful escape into this charming and dynamic world.
